name: Milk (cow)
description: The daily glass, chai base, and kheer canvas.

tcm.note: Neutral-moistening; TCM uses it for dryness.

ayurveda.note: The classic cooling, building food — warm milk is still shita-virya.

unani.note: Doodh is thanda-tar; hence warming additions like haldi or saffron.

histamine.note: Fresh pasteurized milk is low; the aged/fermented dairy family is where trouble starts.

nutrition.highlight: calcium in the form the body handles best

guna.note: Fresh milk is sattvic; the texts treat it differently once it sours or ages.
